newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch EOE extends gold and silver options trading.
newsitem.headline: Dutch EOE extends gold and silver options trading.

text.p: The European Options Exchange (EOE) said on Wednesday its had extended the trading hours for gold and silver options on the Amsterdam exchange.
The options will now be available for trade from 0915 local (0815 GMT) instead of 0930 local (0830 GMT). The end of trading remains at 1630 local (1530 GMT), it said in a statement.
A EOE spokesman said the change had been made to avoid a simultaneous start to gold, silver and dollar options trading.
"This will allow a better starting position for the gold and silver options," he said.
